name: square_v6_engine_exercise
title: Square V6 four-stroke engine (MCI TP3 exercises 1-3)
summary: Teaching exercise on one square V6 four-stroke engine (bore = stroke): exercise 1 computes bore/stroke, clearance volume and piston kinematics at the end of the combustion; exercise 2 shaft and indicated power, brake mean effective pressure and friction losses; exercise 3 (default) mixture mass per cycle, fuel and air mass flows, volumetric efficiency, specific fuel consumption and thermal efficiency. The exercise is selected by the string Exercice$ ($IF).

origin.course: Machines, combustion et energie (ULiege), TP3, exercises 1-3

verification.summary: Runnable variant _coolsolve (native over-determined by one redundant identity in the default branch) compared with the EES stored solution of MCI_TP3_EX-1-2-3.EES: compare_solution.py --ees-units, 31 common variables, 0 differ at rtol=0.001, max rel. diff 8.33e-04 (epsilon_v; EES vs CoolProp R#, molar masses, air density). Exercises 1 and 2 branches reproduce the stored values.
verification.reference: EES stored solution of MCI_TP3_EX-1-2-3.EES (45 names decoded by ees_extract.py; EES X10.589)
